text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Mayano 
Top Gun said there was somewhere she 
wanted to stop by, so I followed along, 
but...
choice_data_list:
Did you forget something in the school 
building?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Nope! Guess what, guess what! I heard an 
amazing rumor from Mave-chin today~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
""Couples who share a heart-thumping 
moment on the rooftop under the starry sky 
will find true happiness"... it says!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Kyaaan☆ So romantic and wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Right? Right? It's gonna be tons of fun, 
so let's go together!"
choice_data_list: Oh, what am I going to do with you...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Now I can spend time with Trainer... 
ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! You know what? Apparently it's 
a fail if anyone spots you on the way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You copy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right! Well then, entering stealth 
mode... Takeoff☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
“—Notice from the flagship to all units! 
No enemy shadows in sight... Over!”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! With this, I feel like I could 
zoom straight up to the roof...
(Flap flap... flap flap...!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...!! Trainer, what you just said...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that... aren't they heading 
this way?! Wh-What should we do?!
choice_data_list: Let's hide and wait it out

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah! Then let's head to that classroom—
(...*patter patter*... *patter*...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, this feels just like 
hide-and-seek, I'm getting kind of 
excited♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa! No, no, no good! Be quiet, 
shh...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu... Trainer-chan's eyelashes have a 
little curl to them, so cute~♪)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, somehow... he looks cooler than 
usual...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...No waaaay, you caaaan't—!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah☆ What a surprise! Did you forget 
something in the classroom too, Mayano??

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "H-Huh? Mave-chin!?"
choice_data_list: Looks like we got found out.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!! That's right! My heart was racing 
so much I totally forgot~~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see! So you were doing that good luck 
charm?? But, but~...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If it got your heart racing, then that's 
Marvelous☆, isn't it?★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... you might be right. Even without a 
good-luck charm...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa!! It's nothing, it's nothing! It 
was a failure anyway, so let's hurry 
home!!

Hurried along by Mayano Top Gun, I ended 
up heading home without ever learning the 
true meaning behind the good luck charm...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see! So I just have to run away so they 
don't find me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-chan! Lend me a hand, 
will ya?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Because Maya is waaaay faster! Come on, 
come on, hurry up, hurry up!"

Urged on by the approaching footsteps, I 
was pulled by the hand by Mayano Top Gun—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, you can do it, you can do 
it! Just a little bit more--!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: We're here!! We did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: At the very end, here, the stars—...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~...! Trainer-chan, the sky! Look at 
the sky, look look!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Amaaaziiing! Was the night sky always this 
sparkly!?
choice_data_list: All that hard work really paid off!
All that hard work was worth it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're right! Maybe the stars are 
looking so pretty because we both worked 
so hard together!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! Let's head back soon, then!

If we go by the rumors, it's supposed to 
be 'a heart-pounding moment on the rooftop 
under the starlit sky'... right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Maya's going home already! 'Cause 
Maya just figured it out earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even if we don't do anything, Maya and the 
others...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway! That's just how it is! So let's 
hurry home, okay?

Finding Mayano Top Gun's shyness 
endearing... we walked home together under 
a sky full of stars.
